reply: Restarting won't help (coordinator, measured in its container, 12:41 CST). Every new cloud session starts from a saved copy of the environment, and that copy holds claude-settings as of Nov 4 07:09 UTC (d7eb5c94). The fix that runs the fresh start-up hooks (#1195) merged at 08:33 UTC that day, after the copy was made. So every new lane still prints the old line: 31 of them, including lanes started today. The fix is yours to do: open the cloud environment menu in a session's title bar, choose Edit, and save any change to the Setup script, such as a comment line with today's date. That rebuilds the copy, and new sessions then start current. I also filed step cloud-snapshot-age-check: the start-up hook will warn once when the copy falls behind main on a change that matters.
